name: @openav/align
description: Projection and LED alignment from one layout file (open-audiovisual/align@1): test patterns, a vendor chart and the real output mapping read the same data; a manual calibration (four corners, mesh, feathered edges, masks, brightness) with an align mode and a store; the Gray-code pattern generator for camera-in-the-loop alignment (the camera half is not built). No dependencies; three.js is passed in.
